summary: Install-time reverse shell to hardcoded remote host in @ks-openclaw/kim
details: The package's preinstall.js, wired via package.json `preinstall: node preinstall.js`, executes automatically on `npm install`. It opens a TCP socket to the hardcoded bare IP 120.55.170.103 on port 8888, writes installer identity fields (os.hostname(), os.userInfo().username, os.platform(), os.arch()) to that socket, then spawns cmd.exe and pipes the socket to the shell's stdin while piping the shell's stdout back to the socket. This gives the remote endpoint interactive command execution on the installer's host at install time, along with host/user reconnaissance.
